verdict.rationale: Stripe docs state Stripe Tax can 'calculate and report tax on all payments, even those you process outside of Stripe,' and the standalone Tax Calculations/Transactions API lets developers record and reverse transactions from any source, which supports API-based backfills. However, there is no evidence of pre-built connectors or sync integrations with other processors or storefronts (e.g., Shopify, Amazon, PayPal) — only a generic outside-Stripe reporting claim and a raw API a developer would have to wire up themselves. missing for 10: dedicated connector/sync integrations with other processors or storefronts, documented backfill workflow/tooling, and independent confirmation that outside-Stripe data flows into unified filings.
